# RAWRXD ENTERPRISE CLOSURE ΓÇö BATCH 024 (15 + 15 + 15)

**Open acceptance gates, not 45 accomplished fixes.** The only change already committed in this session is the isolated fused GEMV candidate in draft PR #55. Prior source baselines and original GGUF models stay unchanged. Every checked item requires a revision-specific receipt; source presence or a static test cannot substitute for runtime success.

**Refs / provenance**
- Canonical stable baseline: `preservation/source-baseline-20261021` (`7d5106b3b318e59c920d144f760e954d41c11768`)
- Experimental REAP branch: `feature/reap-deepseek-671b-150tps` (`3083edf6b6d226c335181ea21f80549adc6ee478`), draft PR #53
- Isolated throughput recovery: `audit/fused-gemv-recovery-20261024` (`fa503b4a7f618e9cd40445bfab3c32963b1cca77`), draft PR #55
- Slingshot legacy source: `ItsMehRAWRXD/RawrXD-IDE-Final` / `src/rawrxd_slingshot_braid.cpp`, `src/hotpatch/SlingshotGuard.cpp`, `SlingshotPOC.cpp` (currently simulated VRAM)
- Legacy compiler script: `RawrXD-IDE-Final/BUILD_ALL_72_COMPILERS.ps1` hardcodes unavailable MSVC 14.50 / Windows SDK 22621 / D: paths; `compilers/all_69/nasm_ide_compiler.asm` only prints a banner/status, NOT a NASM assembler implementation
- Current actions run #40089650136 failed within 3 seconds, `steps=[]`, `runner_id=0` on both Windows and Linux; compiler and regression tests DID NOT RUN. Exact infrastructure cause unverified.

## A. Native IDE E2E and source/dependency closure (15)
- [ ] 01. Resolve GitHub Actions jobs failing with runner_id=0 and no steps; capture a successful Linux + Windows run
- [ ] 02. Re-run source-only per-file SHA-256 inventory on the audited commit; archive machine-readable JSON
- [ ] 03. Re-run CMake literal-source admission; disposition every missing path
- [ ] 04. Run strict no-external-dependencies scan; remove or explicitly quarantine Qt/nlohmann production-link dependencies
- [ ] 05. Establish frozen manifest mapping each feature to the actual compiled translation unit and call site
- [ ] 06. Rebuild real native Win32 IDE from clean checkout using no-Qt flags
- [ ] 07. Rebuild `rawr.exe` and snapshot/agent targets from the same clean checkout
- [ ] 08. Launch Win32 IDE and save, close, reopen and compare file SHA-256
- [ ] 09. Verify terminal start, output stream, exit code, cancellation and process cleanup
- [ ] 10. Verify native PowerShell panel command output, terminal lifecycle and restart
- [ ] 11. Verify complete native LSP JSON-RPC process handshake, diagnostics, definitions and completion
- [ ] 12. Verify GhostText inline completion display, accept/cancel and real model adapter
- [ ] 13. Verify native browser rendering, network/origin isolation and lifecycle
- [ ] 14. Verify debugger breakpoints, step, watch, variable/stack windows in a real debuggee
- [ ] 15. Prove IDE-driven agent edit ΓåÆ build ΓåÆ test ΓåÆ snapshot rollback with source diff and evidence

## B. Slingshot source, native compiler/linker and cross-platform outputs (15)
- [ ] 01. Recover the exact `src/rawrxd_slingshot_braid.{hpp,cpp}` format owners from legacy repo with hashes
- [ ] 02. Validate SBraid emitter/read-back with independent binary-format roundtrip + corrupt/truncated file rejection
- [ ] 03. Review `SlingshotGuard.cpp` concurrency/integrity constraints before native Deep2 integration
- [ ] 04. Replace `SlingshotPOC.cpp` simulated VRAM/fake weights with real allocator and measured prefetch if promoted
- [ ] 05. Reconcile legacy source against canonical Deep2 tensor residency and model loader; no speculative blind merge
- [ ] 06. Recover compiler and linker source inventory from MASM, native, and independent-ancestry branches
- [ ] 07. Prove native `C` frontend compiles representative portable C programs
- [ ] 08. Prove general native `C++20` frontend compiles templates/exceptions/ABI samples (not just return constants)
- [ ] 09. Prove MASM x86 and x64 syntax, relocation and COFF interoperability with independent assembler oracle
- [ ] 10. Prove NASM x86 and x64 syntax, relocation and object interoperability with independent assembler oracle
- [ ] 11. Prove rawrxd native linker PE32 and PE32+ startup, imports, sections, relocations, exports
- [ ] 12. Prove full compile ΓåÆ link ΓåÆ execute with no external compiler for supported C/C++/MASM/NASM subsets
- [ ] 13. Define capability versus host-toolchain fallback for ELF/Linux output; run Linux native executable smoke
- [ ] 14. Define Mach-O/macOS and iOS code signing and target SDK/toolchain contracts, with actual macOS runner evidence
- [ ] 15. Define Android ABI, ELF/shared library and APK packaging/device contracts, with actual Android test evidence

## C. GPU correctness, 150 TPS, Top-25 parity and release (15)
- [ ] 01. Build deterministic reference model/quant baseline; archive tokenizer, template, logits and token receipts
- [ ] 02. Verify corrected `ffn_gate_up` multi-token path on GPU before performance promotion
- [ ] 03. Verify Deep2 Q4_K, Q5_K, Q6_K and F32 fused host GEMV against independent numerical oracles
- [ ] 04. Compare four recovered fused GEMV paths to pre-patch queue submit/fence wait counts
- [ ] 05. Verify lane-state restoration across success, error, fallback, and dual-GPU paths
- [ ] 06. Measure exact R9700 single-GPU TPS for 32/128/256 tokens with paired control
- [ ] 07. Measure exact RX7800 XT single-GPU TPS for 32/128/256 tokens with paired control
- [ ] 08. Measure dual-GPU full-model TPS on both discrete devices with strict no-fallback counters
- [ ] 09. Attribute GPU0 fence waits and GPU1 overlap using timestamps and PCIe transfer receipts
- [ ] 10. Certify GGUF shard/index, quant and architecture parsing on user-supported model matrix
- [ ] 11. Check Nemotron SSM Q4_K NaN and residual parity across reference boundaries
- [ ] 12. Benchmark real model 150+ single-stream decode TPS if attainable; never report synthetic kernel TPS
- [ ] 13. Require identical model, sampling, seed, context, clocks/thermal and residency for performance A/B
- [ ] 14. Apply 25 IDE ├ù20 capability = 500 cell feature matrix with real test evidence; do not prefill certification
- [ ] 15. Certify signed/reproducible packaging, security, crash/rollback, offline, cross-platform and release acceptance

## Release law
Mark gates PASS only with reproducible executable evidence identifying the tested commit. No guarantee for 150 TPS on the existing 48 GB combined VRAM, no claimed 100% enterprise completeness, and no claim of independent native frontend support for Apple/Android/Linux/Windows until each target is actually linked and run. Native GPU tests need a registered self-hosted R9700 + RX 7800 XT runner. Preserve existing CI failures and benchmark receipts, do not force-promote or overwrite canonical source.
title: RawrXD batch 024: 45 E2E native IDE, Slingshot/compiler and GPU release gates
